verdict.rationale: Docs mention that Workers 'fits into your existing workflows: Git, GitHub Actions' implying repo-based CI/CD, and support for many frameworks out of the box, but the evidence pack lacks explicit description of a zero-config 'connect repo and deploy' flow (e.g., automatic framework/build detection like Pages does) or hands-on confirmation that no manual build setup is needed. missing for 10: explicit docs on automatic build configuration detection, dashboard 'connect GitHub repo' walkthrough, and independent confirmation of a truly no-config deploy experience.
